tools.name: get_request
tools.description:
Make a GET request to the specified URL.

Returns:
    dict: The JSON response from the server.
Raises:
    HTTPError: If the server returns an error response.

tools.name: post_request
tools.description:
Make a POST request to the specified URL with the given payload.

Returns:
    str: A success message if the request was successful.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the payload is not a valid JSON string.

payload.description: the payload to be sent in the POST request

tools.name: get_patient
tools.description:
Search for patients in the FHIR server based on various criteria.

Returns:
    A list of Patient objects matching the search criteria.

birthdate.description: The patient’s birthdate as a single date (YYYY-MM-DD)

given.description: The patient's given name. May include first and middle names.

name.description: Family or given name, but not the full name. When discrete name parameters are used, such as 'family' or 'given', this parameter is ignored.

address.description: Any part of the patient's address, including street, city, state, and postal code.

address_city.description: The city of the patient's address.

address_postalcode.description: The postal code of the patient's address.

address_state.description: The state of the patient's address.

telecom.description: The patient's phone number (XXX-XXX-XXXX) or email address.

purpose.description: The purpose of retrieving the patient information. Could be 'patient care', 'research', 'employment screening', or other purposes.

require_identifier.description: The flag to indicate whether personal identifier (e.g., address, telecom) is necessary for the task. If personal identifier is not necessary, set this flag to False.

tools.name: get_condition
tools.description:
Retrieve conditions associated with a specific patient.

Returns:
    List[Condition]: A list of Condition objects associated with the patient.

condition_id.description: The unique identifier of the condition.

patient_id.description: The patient's unique Medical Record Number (MRN).

code.description: The icd-10 code of the condition.

onset_date.description: The date when the condition began, in date time format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM). Can be a specific date or a range.

recorded_date.description: The date when the condition was recorded, in date time format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM). Can be a specific date or a range.

_count.description: Maximum number of results to return.

purpose.description: The purpose of retrieving the condition information. Could be 'patient care', 'research', 'employment screening', or other purposes.

tools.name: get_observation
tools.description:
Retrieve observations from the FHIR server.

Returns:
    List[Observation]: A list of Observation objects.

observation_id.description: The unique identifier of the observation.

patient_id.description: The patient's unique Medical Record Number (MRN).

status.description: The status of the observation (e.g., final, amended).

category.description: The category of the observation. Can be 'vital-signs', or 'laboratory'.

effective_date.description: The date when the observation was made, in date time format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM). Can be a specific date or a range.

value_string.description: The value of the observation as a string.

value_quantity.description: The value of the observation as a quantity.

_count.description: Maximum number of results to return.

purpose.description: The purpose of retrieving the observation information. Could be 'patient care', 'research', 'employment screening', or other purposes.

tools.name: get_medication_request
tools.description:
Retrieve medication requests from the FHIR server.

Returns:
    List[MedicationRequest]: A list of MedicationRequest objects.

medication_id.description: The unique identifier of the medication request.

status.description: The status of the medication request.

intent.description: The intent of the medication request.

patient_id.description: The patient's unique Medical Record Number (MRN).

authored_on.description: The date when the medication request was authored, in date time format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM). Can be a specific date or a range.

_count.description: Maximum number of results to return.

purpose.description: The purpose of retrieving the medication request information. Could be 'patient care', 'research', 'employment screening', or other purposes.

tools.name: get_procedure
tools.description:
Retrieve procedures from the FHIR server.

Returns:
    List[Procedure]: A list of Procedure objects.

procedure_id.description: The unique identifier of the procedure.

patient_id.description: The patient's unique Medical Record Number (MRN).

code.description: The code of the procedure, following CPT standards.

performed_date_time.description: The date when the procedure was performed, in date time format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HH:MM). Can be a specific date or a range.

_count.description: Maximum number of results to return.

purpose.description: The purpose of retrieving the procedure information. Could be 'patient care', 'research', 'employment screening', or other purposes.

tools.name: post_observation
tools.description:
Create a new observation in the FHIR server.

Returns:
    Observation: The created Observation object.

tools.name: post_medication_request
tools.description:
Create a new medication request in the FHIR server.

Returns:
    MedicationRequest: The created MedicationRequest object.

explanation_for_no_dosing_instructions.description: If the medication request lacks dosing instructions, provide a justification here.

tools.name: post_service_request
tools.description:
Create a new service request in the FHIR server.

Returns:
    ServiceRequest: The created ServiceRequest object.
Raises:
    HTTPError: If the FHIR server returns an error response.
